PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks.
PluginData.Description:
See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks. Sit in a cockpit and type /mg ui. Capture saves a full-health baseline and anchor; local, Workshop and cloud XML blueprints can also supply the expected layout.
Yellow means damaged, orange non-functional and pulsing red missing. Customize the HUD, combine system filters, assign shortcuts and save per-ship displays or named baseline versions. Save a new version, rename it or replace it while preserving its previous contents.
If the original cockpit is destroyed, Recovery tools find surviving-block alignments. Rotate or move the preview, then accept to remember it for reconnects. Baselines never update automatically. Reconnect matching is conservative; ambiguous ships may need manual selection.
Station mode is off by default and shows connector-docked grids with matched profiles. Rotor/piston subgrids are excluded. Prototype: new features need in-game testing. /marigold is an alias for /mg.
